text: The debugging technique of halving the region in which a fault can lie, by observing state at the midpoint and then repeating, is called ___ .
explanation: It is binary search applied to a program rather than to an array, and `git bisect` applies it to a project's history — halving the range of commits in which a regression was introduced. Chapter 32 explains why it is so effective: each observation carries about one bit, so ten of them narrow a thousand candidates and twenty narrow a million.
